# UX Manual Checklist

Use this checklist when repo-native automated evidence is incomplete.

## Scope
- Goal:
- Changed paths:
- Primary user journeys:
- Components / routes touched:

## Usability
- [ ] System status is visible during pending work
- [ ] Labels use user language rather than internal jargon
- [ ] The user can cancel, close, or back out when appropriate
- [ ] Errors help the user recover
- [ ] The UI is consistent with nearby patterns
- [ ] The design avoids unnecessary clutter

## Accessibility
- [ ] Keyboard navigation works end-to-end
- [ ] Focus is visible and not obscured
- [ ] Dialogs / menus trap and return focus appropriately
- [ ] Form controls have labels and discoverable instructions
- [ ] Validation and status messages are perceivable
- [ ] Headings and landmarks are meaningful
- [ ] Contrast was measured or inherited from trusted tokens
- [ ] Target sizes are reasonable for the density of the UI

## Content
- [ ] Button labels are action-oriented
- [ ] Error messages explain what happened and what to do next
- [ ] Empty states explain what the screen is for
- [ ] Success states confirm completion clearly

## States
- [ ] Loading
- [ ] Empty
- [ ] Validation
- [ ] Error
- [ ] Success
- [ ] Disabled / unavailable
- [ ] Partial success / retry (if relevant)

## Design system
- [ ] Existing components were reused
- [ ] Tokens and spacing match nearby code
- [ ] Naming is consistent across files and surfaces

## Evidence captured
- Commands or checks run:
- Manual observations:
- Blockers:
- Non-blocking findings:
